title: AnomalyModel
description: Model slot, catalog row anomaly-model 1.0.1: the inference contract of the denoising autoencoder that scores how far an operating result lies from the engine's training manifold, written by data-pipeline/pipeline/stages/train.py to data/derived/models/psd-ae.json beside the ONNX graph data/derived/models/psd-ae.onnx. The input is the 14 features of feature_order built from an engine result (log10 of p80_mm, p50_mm and p20_mm, the five product fractions passing, throughput_tph, power_kw, reduction_ratio, log10 of f80_mm, specific_energy_kwh_t, feed_m) standardised as (value - mean) / std; the graph's input x has shape [1, 14] and its output xr the reconstruction of the same shape. The score is the mean squared reconstruction error over the 14 values; a score above threshold_p99 (the 99th percentile of the scores on the training draw) marks the point anomalous. The slot's baseline is the engine's envelope gate (pipeline.model.crusher.envelope): a rule check that flags a point outside the physical and calibrated envelope. Applicability: training.input_ranges is the operating domain of the engine draw the model was trained on; the model scores only a point that is not calibrated and inside those ranges, else the envelope gate answers with the reason. Rules the schema cannot state, checked by the producer test: mean and std have the length of feature_order, every std is positive, and the ONNX file exists with the sha256 given.

engine_version.description: The product version whose engine produced the training draw.

feature_order.description: The 14 features built from an engine result, in the order of the graph's input.

mean.description: The mean of each feature on the training draw, in feature_order (the input is standardised as (value - mean) / std).

std.description: The standard deviation of each feature on the training draw, in feature_order.

threshold_p99.description: The 99th percentile of the reconstruction scores on the training draw; a score above it marks the point anomalous (mean squared error of the standardised features).

train_recon_mean.description: The mean reconstruction score on the training draw (mean squared error of the standardised features).

path.description: The graph file, relative to data/derived.

bytes.description: The size of the graph file [bytes].

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the graph file bytes.

opset.description: The ONNX operator set the graph is exported with.

input.description: The name of the graph's input tensor, x.

output.description: The name of the graph's output tensor, xr (the reconstruction).

graph.description: The exported graph of the autoencoder.

architecture.description: The layer sizes, for example 14-16-6-16-14, and the input noise used in training.

seed.description: The seed of the training draw and of torch.

n_train.description: The number of operating points the autoencoder was trained on.

noise_std.description: The standard deviation of the Gaussian noise added to the standardised input in training.

input_ranges.description: The operating domain of the engine draw the model was trained on, per machine.

torch_version.description: The torch release the autoencoder was trained with.

export_parity_max_abs.description: The maximum absolute difference between the trained torch module and the exported graph (run through onnxruntime) on the held-out draw, in standardised feature units.

inputRanges.description: The training range of every continuous input, per machine: [low, high] of the training draw, inclusive, written by train.py from sweep.RANGES with no rounding. The applicability rule of both sides reads it: a model answers an operating point only when the point is not calibrated and every continuous input lies inside its machine's range; otherwise the slot's baseline answers, labelled with the reason (calibrated_case, or outside_training_range:<input>).

cone-sec.description: The training ranges of the secondary cone.

cone-tert.description: The training ranges of the tertiary cone.

jaw.description: The training ranges of the jaw crusher.

cone-short-head.description: The training ranges of the short-head cone.

gyratory.description: The training ranges of the gyratory crusher.

ore_axb.description: Ore competence A times b range.

machineRanges.description: [low, high] of every continuous input for one machine.
